integrity: The full deterministic finite certificate and standard-library checker are embedded. No independent scientific or priority validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Provides a sufficient resetting-to-gap interval [1/5,1/2] and one of five finite pairs of witness times, not a sharp threshold or classification outside the interval. The general Kummer expression is from prior literature; the new claim is a strict continuum backflow bound certified by exact rational inequalities and Poisson coupling.
title: A uniform information-backflow band for quantum resetting with positive-rate memory
